title: Three Summers and One Short Shelf
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与家居）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与家居）　|　核心词汇：fridge　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fridge 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my grandmother ① bought a fridge that no neighbour in the street would have opened, and she said the buying was the whole of the summer. The ② fridge, meaning the box itself and not the cellar, ran three summers and stayed unopened in the book; a fridge, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unopened.

Every ③ fridge in that street had the same short shelf beside it, and the ④ fridge at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fridge, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to open; my grandmother said the opening is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fridge was the whole of the matter, meaning the cold room and not the box. The ⑥ fridge, meaning the cold room and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody opens; fridge, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both a box and a cold room. He said the cold room is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ fridge had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short shelf. The ⑧ fridge of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in July, was one street and three summers of opening; fridge, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to open. She said the opening was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fridge I remember is the one opened in the plan, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the street. A ⑩ fridge, my mother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being opened; every fridge, she said, is a cold room that has agreed to look like a box. She said the cold room was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 冰箱（指街上每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 冰箱（指那一台本身，与地窖相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy a fridge 买一台冰箱
D. n. 冰箱（指留给孩子们的那一台）
E. n. 冰箱（抽象总称，指一条街上的冰箱之事）
F. n. 冰箱（指计划里写到、被打开过的那一台）
G. n. 冷藏室；冷库（指冷藏空间，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 冷藏室（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: bought a fridge that no neighbour in the street would have opened
The fridge, meaning the box itself and not the cellar
the fridge at the far end
the fridge was the whole of the matter
The fridge, meaning the cold room
the fridge had become a line in a plan
The fridge of the whole thing

answers.why: buy a fridge 意为“买一台冰箱”，1968 年祖母买了一台街上没有一位邻居肯打开的冰箱。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，指那一台本身而不是地窖，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被打开。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，指街上每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一层矮矮的搁板。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，指留给孩子们的那一台，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fridge 意为“冷藏室、冷库”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这间冷藏室就是那件事的全部。
fridge 意为“冷藏室”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那台冰箱，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，指计划里写到、被打开过的那一台，到 1975 年这一台成了计划里的一行。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，祖母七月写道，整件事的冰箱之事是一条街道和三个夏天的打开。
fridge 意为“冰箱”，我记得的是计划里被打开过的那一台，1977 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一台。
fridge 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，一台冰箱是唯一会因为被好好打开而变得更好的东西。

那台冰箱，指的是那一台本身而不是地窖，经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被打开。（fridge）
那条街上每一台冰箱旁边都有同一层矮矮的搁板。（fridge）
最远那头那台冰箱，指的是他们留给孩子们的那一台，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（fridge）
叔叔说这间冷藏室就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那台冰箱。（fridge）
1979 年母亲说，一台冰箱是唯一会因为被好好打开而变得更好的东西。（fridge）

The fridge at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
